items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: See, we had Bill Nolan; he played drums and sang with us.

ctx.x: No. See, we had Bill Nolan; he played drums and sang with us. She never sang.
Well, one thing I was going to say to you: I take it in those days that Earl and Chicago, because of radio, was probably a fairly big influence in Kansas City, wasn't it?
